e: One or more PhD positions modelling compact binaries in astrophysical and dark-matter environments and interpreting LISA and next-generation ground-based GW observations. Requires an MSc in physics, astronomy or a related field by the start date; apply via AcademicJobsOnline.
n: GRAPPA, University of Amsterdam: PhD in gravitational-wave astrophysics and dark matter (ERC De Tenebris)
